statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail is 19% while Stress is 99%.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold; the mapped public policy state is EA_ON. Weekend geopolitical and energy-supply risk keeps Stress extreme ahead of NQ reopening.
headline: Low Tail, extreme weekend stress while NQ remains closed
body: NQ futures are weekend-closed, so no current tape can confirm persistent extension, shallow pullbacks or failed retracements. Friday's broad U.S. equity rebound and fresh latest-session tech breadth conflict with the Saudi pipeline and Red Sea disruptions. The evidence supports extreme Stress without a Tail block.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail moved from the watch band late Friday to the low band after the cash close. Stress rose from the low 90s to 99% as Saudi pipeline and Red Sea risks intensified during the weekend closure, while no new NQ price-path evidence became available.
outlookSummary: The full 24-hour forecast ends six hours before the scheduled Sunday NQ reopen. Tail remains low at 19% because no live one-way path can be observed; Stress stays extreme at 98-99% on unresolved Saudi pipeline and Red Sea risks. The next decisive evidence is the reopening gap, retracement depth and cross-asset alignment.
